title: Displacement Cardiography
item_service_description: <p> Displacement cardiography, including cardiokymography and photokymography, is a noninvasive diagnostic test used in evaluating coronary artery disease.</p>
revision_history: <p> 09/1988 - Cardiokymography covered for certain indications.&#160;Photokymography remained noncovered. Effective date 10/12/1988. (TN 33)</p>
